Name: Maggie PLD Complete
Description: Complete Paladin event profile based on Jasper's dungeon-and-raid structure and checked against BossMod priorities. Opener stays enabled; Save CD is manual only; Fight or Flight, Requiescat, Confiteor, Atonement, interrupts and mitigation remain enabled.

Events.Name: Emergency Hallowed
Events.Description: Uses Hallowed Ground around 30 percent HP before lethal low-HP windows.

Events.Name: Clemency Emergency
Events.Description: Uses Clemency on self during early emergency windows above the Hallowed Ground floor.

Events.Name: Sheltron
Events.Description: Uses Holy Sheltron around 85 percent HP as soon as Oath is available, smoothing tank damage before panic windows.

Events.Name: Second Pack Mitigation
Events.Description: Adds the second mitigation layer only if a large pull keeps pressuring HP, preserving staggered coverage.

Events.Name: First Pack Mitigation
Events.Description: Begins the dungeon mitigation ladder near 80 percent HP on 3+ enemy pulls, leaving room for later tools.

Events.Name: Low-HP Mitigation
Events.Description: Adds mitigation when HP is falling and no major mitigation is active.

Events.Name: Final Boss Check
Events.Description: Allows final burn behavior once the boss is near 5 percent HP.

Events.Name: Co-tank Support
Events.Description: Uses Intervention on the lowest-health party member around 55 percent HP for earlier buddy mitigation support.

Events.Name: Interject Cast Stop
Events.Description: Stops interruptible enemy casts with Interject when in range.

Events.Name: Arm's Length Pack Slow
Events.Description: Uses Arm's Length on normal dungeon pulls when you are stationary and the targets should live long enough.

Events.Name: Wipe Reset OT Stance
Events.Description: Optional off-tank stance release, left disabled by default.

Events.Name: Out-of-Combat Reset
Events.Description: Returns Paladin ACR toggles to their standard out-of-combat state.

Events.Name: Zone Reset
Events.Description: Paladin defaults are reapplied after changing zones.

Events.Name: Wipe Reset
Events.Description: Paladin defaults are reapplied after a wipe.

Events.Name: Wipe Reset MT Stance
Events.Description: Main-tank stance setup for roulettes and dungeon pulls.

Events.Name: Zone Reset MT Stance
Events.Description: Reapplies main-tank stance setup after changing zones.

Events.Name: Manual Provoke Swap
Events.Description: Manual Provoke moves the profile into MT behavior, enables Iron Will, and spends Holy Sheltron as a light swap defensive.

Events.Name: MT Loose-Add Pickup
Events.Description: Main-tank loose-add pickup. Requires Iron Will, so stance-off OT play will not Provoke.

Events.Name: Damage State Guard
Events.Description: Maintains Paladin damage/range/magic finisher toggles enabled in combat so the routine resumes normal damage after holds or imports.

Events.Name: Pack AoE Release
Events.Description: Maintains standard UseAOE and Save CD disabled during two-or-more target pulls while leaving ForceAOE manual.

Conditions.Name: Not Top Aggro
Conditions.Description: Current enemy target is not locked to the tank, used for MT add pickup.

Conditions.Name: Iron Will Active
Conditions.Description: Requires Iron Will to be active so OT mode with stance off cannot Provoke or ranged-pull loose adds.

Conditions.Name: [Self] Oath Gauge >= 50
Conditions.Description: Holy Sheltron is available at 50 Oath gauge.

Conditions.Name: Manual Provoke Used
Conditions.Description: Detects a recent manual Provoke as a tank-swap request.

Logics.Name: Emergency Hallowed
Logics.Description: Uses Hallowed Ground around 30 percent HP before lethal low-HP windows.

Logics.Name: Clemency Emergency
Logics.Description: Uses Clemency on self between 26 and 55 percent HP during combat.

Logics.Name: Double Mit
Logics.Description: Second pack mitigation gate: HP near 65 percent with 3+ enemies.

Logics.Name: Single Mit
Logics.Description: First pack mitigation gate: HP near 80 percent with 3+ enemies.

Logics.Name: Auto Sheltron
Logics.Description: Uses Holy Sheltron around 85 percent HP as soon as Oath is available, smoothing tank damage before panic windows without firing at full health.

Logics.Name: Intervention Lowest
Logics.Description: Uses Intervention on the lowest-health party member around 55 percent HP for earlier buddy mitigation support.

Logics.Name: Interject Interrupt
Logics.Description: Stops interruptible enemy casts with Interject when in range.

Logics.Name: Arms Length
Logics.Description: Arm's Length gate for 3+ enemy pulls.

Logics.Name: Stance OT
Logics.Description: Optional off-tank stance release, left disabled by default.

Logics.Name: Reset Toggles
Logics.Description: Returns Paladin ACR toggles to their standard out-of-combat state. Regular UseAOE stays enabled; ForceAOE remains manual and is not changed by this profile.

Logics.Name: [OnWipe] Stance MT
Logics.Description: Main-tank stance setup for roulettes and dungeon pulls.

Logics.Name: DPS Toggle Safety
Logics.Description: Maintains Paladin damage, range, gap-closer, and magic-finisher toggles so the routine resumes normal damage after holds or imports.

Logics.Name: AoE Pack Toggle Release
Logics.Description: Maintains standard UseAOE and Save CD disabled during two-or-more target pulls so Paladin picks up adds and uses AoE without forcing ForceAOE.

Logics.Name: MT Add Pickup
Logics.Description: Uses Provoke plus Paladin's ranged pull action to help pick up loose adds only while Iron Will is active; OT mode with stance off will not taunt.

Logics.Name: Manual Provoke Tank Swap
Logics.Description: Manual Provoke is treated as a tank-swap request: turns Iron Will / MT stance on and uses one short self-mitigation tool.

Items.Name: Last Boss
Items.Description: Enables burn boss at 5 percent HP boss health. Enable this for the last boss of a dungeon, or for any trial/raid with only one phase.

Items.Name: Stun/Int
Items.Description: Uses Low Blow and Interject for general-duty dungeon utility.

Items.Name: Auto TB
Items.Description: Selects tankbuster mitigation for the incoming hit.

Items.Name: Buddy Mit
Items.Description: Optional Intervention support for the lowest-health party member.

Items.Name: MT Stance
Items.Description: Main-tank stance setup for roulettes and dungeons, with loose-add pickup included. Manual Provoke also switches into this MT behavior.

Items.Name: OT Stance
Items.Description: Optional off-tank stance release; manual Provoke is treated as a tank swap and turns MT stance back on.
